# Mastering onboarding | Lauryn Isford (Head of Growth at Airtable)

## Transcript

Lenny Rachitsky (00:00:00):
Chip, you call yourself a modern elder. What does that mean?

Chip Conley (00:00:20):
A modern elder is as curious as they are wise. At Airbnb I was older than most of my colleagues, so I offered wisdom about hospitality while learning about technology from people half my age. Intergenerational teams work best when both sides mentor each other.
